system.name: PhotoAgent
system.one_liner: Autonomous photo-editing agent that plans multi-step edits with tree search and refines them in a closed loop with visual feedback, without step-by-step user prompts.

content.variant_note: left frame diagnoses three pain points of user-driven editing, right frame gives the autonomous agent loop as a ring around a mascot, a photo-result strip underneath
content.argues: Editing no longer needs an expert in the loop: a closed perceive, plan, execute, evaluate cycle turns a photo into an edited result on its own.
content.subject: People-loop complaints, a four-role agent ring with candidate and top-k actions and a score check, and input and output photo pairs.

lessons.what_to_learn: Contrast a user-in-the-loop workflow with the autonomous one by framing both the same way, list the user's pain points as tinted complaint bubbles, draw the agent as a ring of coloured arcs with circled numbers around a mascot, and end with a photo strip under a caption bar that states the result.
lessons.suits: Agent or tool-using systems that replace a manual workflow, where the benefit shows in before and after outputs.

evidence: Upper-Left: People-loop, where users iteratively inspect the image, propose edits, and apply changes until satisfied.
a perceiver that interprets the input image and generates candidate editing actions, an MCTS-based planner that explores and selects potential editing actions
an executor that applies the edits, and an evaluator that assesses the editing results.

summary: PhotoAgent is an autonomous photo-editing system that plans multi-step edits with tree search and refines them in a closed loop with memory and visual feedback, so users no longer write step-by-step instructions. Figure 1 sets two hand-drawn frames side by side. The left 'People-loop paradigm' lists three user complaints (expertise barrier, algorithm selection, interaction complexity) as tinted speech bubbles beside cartoon users. The right 'Agent-loop paradigm' is a ring of four coloured arcs numbered 1 to 4 (Perceiver, Planner with MCTS, Executor, Evaluator) around a fox mascot, with candidate-action, top-k-action and score-check boxes tied to it by dashed curves. A strip of three input and output photo pairs sits under a black caption bar.
summary_zh: PhotoAgent 是自主修图系统。图 1 左侧“人在回路”用三个气泡列出用户的难处，右侧“智能体回路”是围绕狐狸吉祥物的四色环（感知、规划、执行、评估）并配候选动作与评分判断框，底部是输入输出照片对。
notes: The endpoints and directions of some dashed curves (the one from the Executor and Evaluator junction to Edited Image, and the ones at the N Candidate Actions and Top-k Actions boxes) are read from the picture and the paper's component list; the figure has few arrowheads. The thumbs-up person icons are not explained beyond the caption's mention of user-guided editing. All icons appear as bitmaps in the SVG (37 different bitmaps placed). The memory module named in the text is not drawn.
